status.description: See work status and period performance for the selected departments, and print or export to Excel.

directives.description: See current directives by position. Find past directives in Records.

duty.description: See who is on duty yesterday, today and tomorrow, and the monthly or yearly roster.

dutyEdit.description: Edit rotation rules, placement, holidays, shared departments and assignees for each roster.

ictStatus.description: Arrange the ICT status boxes you can see in your own layout, and click one to see details.

calendar.description: See work plans and personal events in one calendar, and select dates to add a personal event.
